domestic.comment: 코스피가 10/13 마감 6,035.35(-5.46%)로 급락하며 6,000선을 간신히 방어했다. morning.insight:
💡 「다른 나라가 1을 내리면, 한국은 3을 내리는 이유」

S&P 500이 -0.2% 숨고르기에 그치는 동안 KOSPI는 -5.46%. 갭은 '반도체 쏠림(시총 상위 비중)'이라는 구조적 요인에서 나온다. 한국 증시가 사실상 삼성전자+SK하이닉스 베팅이라면, 중국 CXMT의 차세대 D램이라는 변수는 그 두 종목의 착시(어닝 서프라이즈에도 주가 급락)를 배로 키운다. 오늘도 AI 자본 조달 비용 상승·관세 불확실성이 남아 있어, 반등하더라도 변동성 국면이 당분간 이어질 것으로 보는 게 현실적입니다.

제니엘 관점에선 어제에 이어 같은 방향의 기회입니다. 고객사들이 자본·인건비 압박을 받을수록 'AI로 업무를 덜어내는 투자'의 설득력은 올라갑니다. 증시가 출렁일수록 보여줄 것은 '감원이 아닌 전환'이라는 메시지 — KPI 설계(Z-P3)와 AX 거버넌스(Z-P4)는 하락장이 주는 여유 시간에 충전하세요.

오늘의 한 줄: 공덕 허브 마감(10/16 15:00)이 이틀 남았습니다. 오늘 아침 30분은 지원서 확인(접수 여부)에, 점심 전까지 밀린 3건 중 1건(주간 업무)을 끝내면 수요일 리듬이 잡힙니다. 저녁엔 김지강·황경아님과 편안한 시간이 기다리고 있어요. ☕️

articles.headline: Pope Leo Diagnosed With Lung Cancer After Surgery
articles.body: The Vatican said Pope Leo XIV was diagnosed with lung cancer after undergoing surgery to remove a growth on his lung.

articles.headline: Gulf Hurricane Not Big Enough to Reset Insurance Market
articles.body: A hurricane that hit the Gulf Coast is unlikely to be large enough to reset property-insurance pricing, analysts said.

articles.headline: Six Flags Closes Several Rides After Georgia Roller-Coaster Death
articles.body: Six Flags closed several rides after a fatal roller-coaster accident in Georgia, the latest safety incident for the theme-park operator.

articles.headline: Oil Rises as Middle East Attacks Increase Uncertainty Over Flows
articles.body: Oil rose as a flare-up in attacks in the Middle East increased uncertainty over a recovery in energy flows from the Persian Gulf.

articles.headline: Aramco Headquarters Hit During Houthi Attack on Saudi Arabia
articles.body: Saudi Aramco's headquarters was struck during a Houthi attack, deepening the threat of a wider Middle East conflict.

articles.headline: Cracks Grow Across the AI Trade as Memory Chip Stocks Tumble
articles.body: Investor faith in the AI trade is showing cracks as memory-chip stocks tumble on worries about oversupply and capital bottlenecks.

articles.headline: White House Says Ambassador Guilfoyle Was Asked to Resign
articles.body: The White House said Kimberly Guilfoyle was asked to resign as US ambassador to Greece after reports of alleged misconduct.

articles.headline: Fed's Collins Sees Higher Rates Likely This Year to Tame Prices
articles.body: Boston Fed President Susan Collins said higher interest rates are likely this year as the central bank works to tame inflation.

articles.headline: Wells Fargo Beats as Resilient Customers Curtail Loan Losses
articles.body: Wells Fargo topped profit estimates as resilient consumers kept loan losses in check, offsetting pressure on net interest income.

articles.headline: Inside Elon Musk's $276 Million Midterm Rescue Mission for Republicans
articles.body: Elon Musk has quietly funneled more than $276 million into Republican groups and his super PAC, building a huge turnout operation to help the party battle midterm headwinds.

articles.headline: Pope Leo Will Have Surgery to Remove Growth on Lung
articles.body: Pope Leo XIV said he would have surgery to remove a small growth on his lung in the coming days, his first medical issue as pontiff.

articles.headline: Saudi and Yemeni Airports Hit in New Round of Strikes
articles.body: The Houthi attacks on the Riyadh airport came amid increasingly brazen strikes by the militia on vital Saudi infrastructure.

articles.headline: Rebuking Ukraine Over Oil Strikes, Trump Says It Should 'Get a New President'
articles.body: President Trump accused Ukraine of causing a 'world problem' with Russian refinery attacks and said it should replace President Zelensky.

articles.headline: Trump Administration Hits International Criminal Court With Severe Sanctions
articles.body: The Trump administration unveiled severe new sanctions against the International Criminal Court, prohibiting transactions with the court.

articles.headline: Millions Lose Private Medicare Plans and Face Rising Costs
articles.body: Millions of people with private Medicare coverage are being forced to change their insurance for 2027 and will pay higher prices.

articles.headline: Katie Zacharia calls on Trump-friendly outlets in brief debut as White House press secretary
articles.body: The new White House press secretary had a short, rocky start, calling on Trump-friendly outlets in her debut briefing.

articles.headline: State Dept. funding delay imperils plan to destroy Syrian chemical weapons
articles.body: A funding delay at the State Department is imperiling a plan to destroy Syria's chemical weapons stockpile.

articles.headline: Archbishop for U.S. military urges Catholics to recuse themselves from firing squad
articles.body: The archbishop for the US military urged Catholic personnel to recuse themselves from firing squads, citing church teaching.

articles.headline: The Riyadh airport attack exposes a new flight path for terror
articles.body: The Houthi drone attack on Riyadh's airport shows how military drones are opening a new flight path for terror against civilian targets.

articles.headline: Hillary Clinton and Kara Swisher to release weekly midterms podcast
articles.body: Hillary Clinton and journalist Kara Swisher are teaming up for a weekly podcast focused on the midterm elections.

articles.headline: Pope Leo enters hospital for surgery on lung nodule
articles.body: Pope Leo XIV entered the hospital for surgery to remove a nodule found on his lung, the Vatican said.

articles.headline: Chip stocks slide as fears mount over scale of AI investment
articles.body: Broadcom's 'casino' comments on AI investing helped push Samsung and SK Hynix down sharply in Seoul as chip stocks slid.

articles.headline: Top economies heading for biggest budget deficits since Covid, IMF warns
articles.body: The IMF warned that top economies are heading for their biggest budget deficits since Covid, calling for 'urgent' action to rebuild public finances.

articles.headline: IMF upgrades outlook for UK as AI drives growth spurt
articles.body: The IMF upgraded its outlook for the UK, believing Britain is emerging as one of the winners of the AI-driven tech boom.

articles.headline: Asia has become the largest producer of zombie companies, IMF warns
articles.body: The share of companies in Asia unable to service their debt has doubled since 2008, the IMF warned.

articles.headline: Trump says he is 'looking at' firing envoy to Greece over alleged misconduct
articles.body: The US president is contemplating dismissing Kimberly Guilfoyle after a report claiming she accepted improper gifts.

articles.headline: China resorts to Nvidia gaming chips in search for AI firepower
articles.body: China's tech giants are snapping up Nvidia gaming chips never designed for advanced AI to satisfy soaring computing demand.
